acceptanceCriteria: A near-miss acceptance note (different punctuation or word order) gets a diagnostic that names the expected form
The accepted forms are documented in docs/SPEC-DRIVEN-DEVELOPMENT.md
A test covers one exact and one near-miss form
body: Lanes recording lane requirements under the 2026-10-11 standing auto-acceptance must spell the acceptance note exactly "(accepted, owner lane auto-acceptance ...)" for the REQUIREMENTS.tsv owner column to parse it. A near miss is silently read as not accepted, and the lane finds out only through a later check. Reported by the dogfood-flow lane on 2026-10-21.
